svg.title: A Fisher-Rao geodesic between two wells
svg.desc: An energy landscape with wells A and B at y = -0.6, a barrier between them and a channel arching over the top. The posterior mean along the spacetime geodesic runs straight through the barrier; the geodesic's x_t over alpha dips far below the wells; the posterior at the midpoint puts 93% of its mass on the two wells and 7% in the channel.
svg.text: Fisher–Rao moves mass by reweighting, not by transport
E[x₀ | γ_s]: stays on the straight line through the barrier
x_t / α along the geodesic: dips to y = −4.5 to keep the channel out
samples of p(x₀ | γ_½): 93% on the two wells, 7% in the channel
